violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut cooked chicken in 1 door warmer unit observed at 120F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC removed the chicken to be reheated in an oven.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: milk cartons, yogurt cups, and ham/cheese/tomato sandwiches observed at 45-47F in the open grab+go display units.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC immediately discarded the foods held in the display units.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the tablet-based ammonia solution in the sanitizer bucket at the pasta station was measured at over 500ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quaternary ammonia solution at 200-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. PIC added water to the sanitizer bucket and tested the solution again to verify concentration around 300ppm.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: OBSERVED A SPRAY NOZZLE ATTACHED TO A HOSE BIBB AT THE MOP SINK WITH AN ATMOSPHERIC BREAK. SYSTEM IS UNDER CONTINUOUS PRESSURE.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PLEASE INSTALL A PRESSURE BLEEDING DEVICE AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS. EHS SHARED INFORMATION OF BACKFLOW PREVENTER WITH CFM.
